parts.name: Segmented
parts.description: A controlled radio group. T extends string and is shared by value, options and onChange. Every option value must be unique.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible group label, rendered as a visually hidden legend.

props.name: value
props.description: Currently selected option value of type T.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the selected option value of type T.

props.name: options
props.description: Ordered radio options with unique string values of type T and visible labels.
